erros.falha: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
erros.semBanco: This part isn't switched on on this server yet.
erros.sem_permissao: Only someone holding that role can do this.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found. Check the @ and whether the person belongs to one of the organization's chapters.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove ID numbers, phone, e-mail or street address: that doesn't go public.
erros.limite: Limit reached. Wait a little or remove something first.
erros.funcao_existe: There is already a role with that name.
erros.sem_vaga: All seats for that role are taken.
erros.ja_ocupa: This person already holds the role.
erros.eleicao_aberta: There is already an open election for that role.
erros.sinais_fechados: The chair hasn't opened the signals yet.
erros.outra_pessoa: The second stamp must come from another treasurer.
erros.ja_conferido: This entry already has both stamps.
erros.ja_tecido: This decision is already a thread on the Loom.
erros.convite_vencido: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask whoever runs the chapter for another.
erros.entre_primeiro: Log in to Alumia to do this.

funcoes.ajuda: Each role has permissions and a term with an end date. Who holds it is shown only to the organization's members.
funcoes.deFora: Who holds each role is shown only to chapter members.
funcoes.sairConfirma: Leave the role “{nome}”? You lose its permissions right away.

permissoes.caixa: records and checks the cash book

funcoes.apagarConfirma: Delete the role “{nome}”? Its terms end with it.
funcoes.indicada: nomination: it only counts if you accept

eleicoes.ajuda: Secret ballot, ranked preference and a quorum written in advance. The winner gets the term automatically.
eleicoes.semQuorum: No minimum quorum (only the 3 votes that protect secrecy).
eleicoes.ordem: Put them in order of preference. The last option, “Reopen the election”, wins if the members want nobody.
eleicoes.votei: Your vote was counted. Nobody knows for whom.
eleicoes.poucos: Fewer than 3 votes: the result isn't shown.

ata.ajuda: The agenda in items, the speakers' queue and the consensus signals. The queue and the signals disappear when the minutes close.
ata.inscreverAjuda: You only see your own position and place. The chair sees the queue by codename.
ata.sinaisAjuda: Your signal only goes into the mosaic, which appears from 3 signals. Nothing individual is kept.
ata.sinaisFechados: The chair opens the signals when it wants to gauge consensus.
ata.poucosSinais: Fewer than 3 signals: the mosaic doesn't show yet.
ata.haBloqueio: There is a block, open the floor.
ata.virarFio: Make it a thread on the Loom (optional)
ata.fecharConfirma: Closing the minutes deletes the speakers' queue and the signals. The stamps stay.
ata.publicar: Publish the minutes as a post
ata.publicada: Published as a post by the organization.
ata.registra: The minutes record the decisions, not who spoke.

caixa.ajuda: Only what two treasurers stamped CHECKED goes into the balance. There is no payment inside Alumia and donors never appear.
caixa.retirarConfirma: Remove this entry? It hasn't been checked twice yet.
caixa.fotoAjuda: The photo is redrawn on your device, without EXIF (place, date, device). Drag over ID numbers, names or addresses to blur them.

problemas.dado_pessoal: Remove ID numbers, phone, e-mail or address: donors never appear.

caixa.fotoGrande: The photo is still too big after shrinking. Try another one.

lampiao.mapa: Put the chapter on the cities map
lampiao.mapaAjuda: Off by default. In a small town, a chapter on the map can help identify people.
lampiao.conviteUsos: How many people can use it
lampiao.conviteAjuda: The code appears only once, here. We keep only a scrambled version of it.
lampiao.entrarComConvite: You arrived with an invitation to one of this organization's chapters.

mapa.ajuda: Only the states and written cities of chapters with a full flame, from organizations with the seal, that chose to appear. No head counts.
mapa.vazio: No lamps on the map yet.
mapa.acendaAjuda: Didn't find your city? Bring your organization and light a chapter.

diretorio.ajuda: Parties, mandates, unions, movements, collectives, student councils and unions with a checked public document. No head counts.

atos.vazio: The organization hasn't called any actions yet.

plenaria.pausada: Updates paused while the tab is hidden
plenaria.salaAjuda: Unlisted YouTube or the institute's room. Shown while the plenary is live.

tear.contasAjuda: What the members decided and what has already been done.
